description: Watch a lane for schedule alerts (PAID): get emailed when a sailing on it is blanked, a booking cut-off is about to close, or a sailing slips. Also alerts on reliability drops. Returns the created watch. Free with Navo Tokens: a watch is configuration, not data.

alert_blank.description: Alert on suspected blank sailings (default true)

alert_cutoff.description: Alert when a booking cut-off is closing (default true)

alert_slip.description: Alert when a sailing slips vs schedule (default true)

carrier_code.description: Optional SCAC to scope the watch to one carrier

name: watch_lane
